item.title: Rattle On!
item.description: In search of some baby favorites this spring? Here is some of our favorite essentials for you or to gift new parents!

item.title: Spring Weekly Playdates
item.description: In search of daily play activities in the community? We've rounded up something to do every day of the week!

item.title: Parents Night Out in Kansas City: April to June 2026
item.description: Take a look at these date night ideas for the spring and early summer in Kansas City! Grab other parents, snag a babysitter and have a fun night out!

item.title: Reading Recess
item.description: We all know little ones will put anything in their mouths — why not make it something delicious after finishing a good book? Make literature come alive on those little taste buds!

item.title: We Love It! NAPPA Awards Reviews
item.description: Perfect for family adventures, seating up to four children comfortably. With reclining, raised seats, five-point harnesses and extra legroom, kids stay safe and cozy.

item.title: For Little Car Lovers: KC Playgrounds with Built-In Race Car Tracks
item.description: Discover the best car-themed playgrounds in Kansas City, including parks with race tracks and traffic gardens. Perfect for kids who love cars and outdoor play.

item.title: Fresh Air and Big Benefits
item.description: When spring arrives, it’s tempting to think outdoor time is more about getting energy out than building health — especially for babies and toddlers who aren’t running laps just yet. But even for the littlest bodies, time outside offers powerful physical, emotional and developmental benefits.

item.title: World Cup Craft
item.description: It’s time to get ready for the World Cup in Kansas City! And what better way to prepare than to craft your own personal soccer field using your children’s fingerprints?

item.title: Hospital Birth
item.description: Every birth story is different. All four of mine have been at a local hospital. I looked at a birthing center or home birth, but decided the best option for me would be the hospital.

item.title: Baby Shower Trends
item.description: I am no expert, but I happen to be in a season of life where baby shower invitations are plentiful. Add in the record number of babies recently born at our church, and I’ve attended more baby showers than I can count over the last few years.
